'''Bespin Motors facilities''' were the manufactories of [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. They were located near [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]], an infamous area of the city.
